description:
As a prospective client I want to describe the project I want built so the team can turn it into an intent.

Dress rehearsal story for the Intent-Driven Saturday harness (INTENT-003).
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/intakes with a client name, a project type (ECOMMERCE, WEBSITE or API) and a description of at least 20 characters returns 201 with a reference like INT-1001 and status RECEIVED
A description shorter than 20 characters returns 400 with the error "Describe what you want in at least 20 characters"
GET /api/intakes/{reference} returns the submitted intake, and an unknown reference returns 404
On the intake page, submitting a valid form shows "Your reference is INT-" followed by the number
On the intake page, a description shorter than 20 characters shows the error message and keeps what the client typed
